Synopsis:
    Dutch police arrested 34 suspects from the Netherlands, Belgium, France and Algeria following a shooting in the rural village of Overasselt. A large group of masked men opened fire on police responding to a suspicious activity report. One civilian died, two officers were hospitalized. Prosecutors indicate this is linked to a long-running conflict — the same property was targeted in a prior incident resulting in two convictions.
